newsitem.title: INDIA: CRICKET-SRI LANKA WIN TOSS, BAT V NEW ZEALAND.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-SRI LANKA WIN TOSS, BAT V NEW ZEALAND.

text.p: and elected to bat against New Zealand in the four-nation
Independence Cup cricket tournament on Tuesday.
Sri Lanka retained the team which beat India last Saturday,
while Craig McMillan and Shane O'Connor replaced seamers Heath
Davis and Andrew Penn in the New Zealand side which lost to
Sri Lanka: Arjuna Ranatunga (captain), Sanath Jayasuriya,
Roshan Mahanama, Marvan Atapattu, Aravinda De Silva, Hashan
Tillekeratne, Romesh Kaluwitharana, Kumara Dharmasena, Chaminda
Vaas, Sajeeva De Silva, Muthiah Muralitharan.
New Zealand: Stephen Fleming (captain), Nathan Astle, Bryan
Young, Matt Horne, Chris Cairns, Adam Parore, Gavin Larsen,
Craig McMillan, Dipak Patel, Chris Harris, Shane O'Connor.
